_doc: Fortree City's buildings (group towns3, notes/TOWNS_TOWNS3.md). The tree houses' doorways are walkable in Sapphire, so plan_map.py finds no footprint for them (and merges House 1 into the Pokemon Center's footprint): the Center and the tree houses are props, x = door column centre (Center: footprint centre), z = door row + (4 - front)/16 with the model's own front: the Center's front wall is 20 (z = door row - 1), the tree houses' cabin front is -12 (models_fortree.py: origin at the door row's south edge, z = door row + 1; until 2026-10-09 they used 20 too and stood two rows north of their doors, behind a strip of ground, House 5 and the Decoration Shop over the cliff of the clearing north of their walkway: map_glitch_fix). Sapphire map tile coordinates. Gym: shared res 320 (group towns1).
